# crisplogs

> Beautiful, colored, and boxed logging for Node.js. One function call returns a configured logger with colors, box decorations, structured data, and optional file output. Zero runtime dependencies, full TypeScript types, dual ESM + CJS.

The library exposes a single primary entry point — `setupLogging` — plus a small set of helpers (`getLogger`, `resetLogging`, `removeLogger`) and the underlying classes (`Logger`, `LogFormatter`, `ConsoleHandler`, `CleanFileHandler`). All public symbols are re-exported from the package root; do not import from internal subpaths. The library is in 0.x and minor bumps may include breaking changes.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): full API reference, options table, output styles, examples
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical imports, the one-call pattern, antipatterns, color string format, custom handlers, exception handling
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md): release notes, including the typed-error migration in 0.3.0

## Examples

- [examples/basic.js](examples/basic.js): default colored output
- [examples/box-styles.js](examples/box-styles.js): all four box styles side-by-side
- [examples/custom-colors.js](examples/custom-colors.js): override per-level colors
- [examples/extra-fields.js](examples/extra-fields.js): structured data with `extraFormat`
- [examples/file-logging.js](examples/file-logging.js): console + file output, ANSI auto-stripped
- [examples/level-filtering.js](examples/level-filtering.js): level thresholds
- [examples/named-loggers.js](examples/named-loggers.js): logger hierarchy with `getLogger`
- [examples/plain-output.js](examples/plain-output.js): no colors
- [examples/custom-date-format.js](examples/custom-date-format.js): strftime tokens

## Source

- [src/index.ts](src/index.ts): `setupLogging`, `getLogger`, `resetLogging`, `removeLogger`, public re-exports
- [src/types.ts](src/types.ts): `Level`, `Style`, `ExtraFormat`, `LogRecord`, `Formatter`, `Handler`, `SetupLoggingOptions`, `LEVEL_VALUES`
- [src/errors.ts](src/errors.ts): `CrisplogsError` base class plus `InvalidLevelError`, `InvalidStyleError`, `InvalidColorError`, `InvalidExtraFormatError`, `InvalidWidthError`, `InvalidFilePathError`
- [src/logger.ts](src/logger.ts): `Logger` class with level methods (`debug`, `info`, `warning`, `warn`, `error`, `critical`, `log`)
- [src/formatters.ts](src/formatters.ts): `LogFormatter` covering all output styles via `FormatterOptions`
- [src/handlers.ts](src/handlers.ts): `ConsoleHandler` (stdout) and `CleanFileHandler` (ANSI-stripped file output)
- [src/colors.ts](src/colors.ts): `parseColorString`, `DEFAULT_LOG_COLORS`, ANSI color tables
- [src/utils.ts](src/utils.ts): `stripAnsi`, `strftime`, `wordWrap`, `getCallerInfo`
